tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: gnam chos thugs gter las las hur drag mo'i sgrub pa bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈ ྈ karma dhā ki ye na ma: las hur drag mo bsgrub pa ni: dkyil 'khor gtor ma dpe'u ris ltar: gzhal yas khang gi dbus su ni: dmigs pa rang nyid las hur ma: dbu drug phyag ni bcu gnyis te: g.yas zhal dkar po g.yon zhal dmar: dbus zhal nag po steng zhal ljang: g.yas zhal ser po g.yon zhal dmar: phyag ni bcu gnyis dang po gnyis: gri gug thod khrag de 'og gnyis: kha ṭwāṃ pad phor de 'og gnyis: phur pa nad rkyal de 'og gnyis: khram shing dbyug to de 'og gnyis: dgra st+wa tho ba de 'og gnyis: gtun shing sbrul gyi zhags pa 'dzin: shin tu 'jigs pa phyed skyil bzhugs: dbu yis lha gnas bsngang bar byed: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo la: lha dmag 'dren nas rdul du brlag: phyag gis gnyan rnams bsngang bar byed: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo la: gnyan dmag bsdus nas rdul du brlag: zhabs kyis klu rnams bsngang bar byed: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo la: klu dmag bsdus nas rdul du brlag: sku stod dgra bo'i pags pa gsol: dug sbrul chun pos ske rags byas: phyag gdub zhabs gdub rna rgyan dang: do shal dug sbrul nag pos byas: sku smad gzig gi sham thabs gsol: glang chen ko rlon sku la gsol: zhal khug gnyis su dgra snying bcug: khrag zhag thal tshom sku la brgyan: de rgyab zhing chen ra ba dang: de rgyab shar gyi pad 'dab la: rdo rje g.yu drag ma la ni: rdo rje phreng ba rdo rje zhags: rdo rje sgrog dang rdo rje sgron: de yi lho yi pad 'dab la: ratna khram drag ma la ni: ratna ti dang ratna kam: ratna rgyug dang ratna mgyogs: de nas nub kyi pad 'dab la: padma nag drag phyogs bzhi'i 'khor: padma smug 'dzin padma phreng: padma sol ba padma mo: de bzhin byang gi pad 'dab la: karma 'grogs chen drag mo la: karma las byed karma mgon: karma mtsho dang karma skyong: de rgyab padma dgu la ni: shar du shing gi kag zlog ma: shar lhor rlung gi kag zlog ma:

lho stod me yi kag zlog ma: lho smad dgra yi kag zlog ma: lho nub sa yi kag zlog ma: nub tu lcags kyi kag zlog ma: nub byang nam mkha'i kag zlog ma: byang du chu yi kag zlog ma: byang shar phyogs kyi kag zlog ma: de rgyab sgo bzhi sgo srung ni: shar du nag mo zor ba'i mgo: lho ru nag mo dred kyi mgo: nub tu nag mo ba glang gdong: byang du nag mo chu srin gdong: de rgyab dur khrod ra ba na: de yi bar khyams brgyad la ni: dkar mo keng rus lus can dang: smug mo srin mo'i lus can dang: dmar mo brag srin lus can dang: ljang mo yug sa'i lus can dang: khra mo phag gi lus can dang: ser mo sbrul gyi lus can dang: sngon mo 'brug gi lus can dang: ljang ser mi sdug lus can dang: de rgyab dur khrod de rgyab me: de rgyab padma rdo ra dang: de rgyab me ri nag po 'bar: gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od kyis ni: ye shes pa ni spyan drangs te: dbang bskur rigs bdag dbu brgyan gyur: bhyo phaṭa hūm̐ du ra na tra tra phaṭa: ༈ ma ma bhyo bhyo bhyo: ma bhyo ma bhyo: du baṃ bhyo bhyo bhyo: ma bhyo ma bhyo: hu baṃ kro te bhyo: ma bhyo bhyo: snga dgra phyi dgra gnod byed thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa: de yis las hur drag mo 'grub: sa ma ya: kha thaṃ gu hya: ྈྈྈ ྈ 'di'i zhal gdams la: sngags bsdu na sbrul shad yan gyis chog: sgrub pa'i sngags grangs dang zhag grangs med do: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gnyis bya lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes brgyad nub las hur drag mo sku gnam sa tsam gcig gis dngos su gsungs so// ༈ // 1$0000250las hur drag mo las shing gi kag zlog yod: 1$0000300༁ྃ: ྈྈྈ ྈ las hur drag mo la phyag 'tshal lo: shing gi kag zlog bsgrub pa ni: dkyil 'khor med cing gtor ma med: spro na dmar gtor gcig bcas so: mdun du shing gi kag zlog ma:

ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: g.yas pas shing lo g.yon drwa ba: lha mo'i chas kun yongs su rdzogs: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis ni: ras ljang 'dung ma sku la gsol: de yi thugs ka'i shaṃ ljang las: 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros: shing gi kag zlog spyan drangs nas: mdun du bskyed pa de la thim: shaṃ ma na shing zlog: de yis shing gi kag zlog 'grub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ gu hya: ྈྈྈ ྈ ces pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum rta chen zla ba'i nyer drug nub lha mo shing gi kag zlog ma nyid kyis phul// ༈ // 1$0000250las hur drag mo las rlung gi kag zlog bzhugs so: 1$0000300༁ྃ: ྈྈྈ ྈ las hur drag mo la phyag 'tshal lo: rlung gi kag zlog ma sgrub thabs: dkyil 'khor med cing gtor ma med: spro na dmar gtor gcig bcas so: mdun du rlung gi kag zlog ljang: g.yas na rlung zhags g.yon sbrul zhags: dar ljang 'dung ma sku la gsol: lha mo'i chas kun yongs su rdzogs: thugs ka'i yaṃ las 'od 'phros pas: rlung gi kag zlog spyan drangs nas: mdun du bskyed pa de la thim: yaṃ ma ra na khaṃ khaṃ ni: mṛ ta ni: rlung zlog: de yis rlung gi kag zlog 'grub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: ྈྈ ྈ ces pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum rta chen zla ba'i nyer bdun nub lha mo rlung gi kag zlog ma nyid kyis dngos su phul ba'o// ༈ // 1$0000250las hur drag mo las me'i kag zlog yod: 1$0000300༁ྃ: ྈྈྈ ྈ las hur drag mo la phyag 'tshal lo: me yi kag zlog sgrub pa ni: dkyil 'khor med cing gtor ma med: spro na dmar gtor gcig bcas so: mdun du me yi lha mo dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gzar bu me: sku la ras dmar 'dung ma gsol: lha mo'i chas rnams yongs su rdzogs: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: de yi thugs kar raṃ las ni: 'od zer dpag tu med 'phros pas:

me yi kag zlog spyan drangs nas: mdun du bskyed pa de la thim: raṃ kha la me zlog: de yis me yi kag zlog 'grub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ gu hya: ྈྈྈ ྈ ces pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum pa rta chen zla ba'i nyer brgyad la lha mo me yi kag zlog ma nyid kyis dngos su phul lo// ༈ // 1$0000250las hur drag mo las dgra'i kag zlog yod: 1$0000300༁ྃ: ྈྈྈྈྈ ྈ las hur drag mo la phyag 'tshal lo: dgra yi kag zlog ma'i sgrub thabs: dkyil 'khor med cing gtor ma med: spro na dmar gtor gcig bcas so: mdun du dgra yi kag zlog ma: dbu ni dmar la lus g.yas ljang: zhabs gnyis sngo la lus g.yon dkar: phyag gnyis dgra st+wa tho ba 'dzin: lus la ras khra'i 'dung ma gyon: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: thugs ka'i khaṃ las 'od 'phros pas: spyan drangs bskyed pa de la thim: khaṃ ma bhyo dgra zlog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ gu hya: ྈ ༈ zhal gdams ni: sku zhi ba'i cha lugs so: 'dung ma ni nang gyon 'dra ba'o: sngags grangs sgrub grangs med: bdag bskyed las hur drag mo bskyed na legs: yi dam gzhan yang rung: zhes pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum pa rta chen zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu nub dgra yi kag zlog ma nyid kyis dngos su phul lo// ༈ // 1$0000250las hur drag mo las sa'i kag zlog gi dbu'o: 1$0000300༁ྃ: ྈྈ ྈ las hur drag mo la phyag 'tshal lo: sa yi kag zlog ma sgrub thabs: dkyil 'khor med cing gtor ma med: spro na dmar gtor gcig bcas so: mdun du sa yi kag zlog ser: zhal gcig phyag gnyis tho ba sgyed: lha mo'i chas kun yongs su rdzogs: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: dar ser 'dung ma sku la gsol: thugs ka'i laṃ las 'od 'phros pas: sa yi kag zlog spyan drangs nas: bsgoms pa de yi sku la thim: laṃ ma na sa zlog:

de yis sa yi kag zlog 'grub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ gu hya: ྈྈྈ ces pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum pa rta chen zla ba'i gnam gang nyin lha mo sa'i kag zlog mas dngos su gsungs so// ༈ // 1$0000250las hur drag mo las lcags kyi kag zlog bzhugs: 1$0000300༁ྃ: ྈྈ ྈ las hur drag mo la phyag 'tshal lo: lcags kyi kag zlog ma sgrub thabs: dkyil 'khor med cing gtor ma med: spro na dmar gtor gcig bcas so: mdun du lcags kyi kag zlog dkar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis lcags cha bram: lha mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: dar dkar 'dung ma sku la gsol: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: thugs ka'i tsaṃ las 'od 'phros pas: lcags kyi kag zlog spyan drangs nas: mdun du bskyed pa de la thim: tsaṃ dmar lcags zlog: de yis lcags kyi kag zlog 'grub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ gu hya: ྈྈྈྈ ྈ ces pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum dbo zla ba'i tshes gcig la lha mo lcags kyi kag zlog ma nyid kyis phul ba'o// ༈ // 1$0000250gnam chos las hur drag mo las nam mkha'i kag zlog yod: 1$0000300༁ྃ: ྈྈ ྈ las hur drag mo la phyag 'tshal lo: gnam gyi kag zlog ma sgrub thabs: dkyil 'khor med cing gtor ma med: spro na dmar gtor gcig bcas so: mdun du nam mkha'i kag zlog sngo: zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'ja' tshon gri: lha mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: dar sngon 'dung ma sku la gsol: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: thugs ka'i e las 'od 'phros pas: nam mkha'i kag zlog spyan drangs bstim: e mo the gnam zlog: de yis gnam gyi kag zlog 'grub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ gu hya: ྈྈྈ ྈ ces pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum pa bya lo dbo zla ba'i tshes gsum nyin lha mo nam mkha'i kag zlog ma nyid kyis dngos su phul ba'o//

༈ // 1$0000250las hur drag mo'i skor las chu'i kag zlog bzhugs so: 1$0000300༁ྃ: ྈྈ ྈ las hur drag mo la phyag 'tshal lo: chu'i kag zlog sgrub pa ni: dkyil 'khor med cing gtor ma med: spro na dmar gtor gcig bcas so: mdun du chu yi kag zlog sngo: zhal gcig phyag gnyis chu rkyal tho: lha mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: dar sngon 'dung ma sku la gsol: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: thugs ka'i khaṃ las 'od 'phros pas: chu yi kag zlog spyan drangs nas: bsgoms pa de yi sku la thim: khaṃ ma ta chu zlog: de yis chu yi kag zlog 'grub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ gu hya: ྈྈ ྈ ces pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum bya lo dbo zla'i tshes bzhi'i nub dpal ldan lha mo chu'i kag zlog ma nyid kyis phul lo// ༈ // 1$0000250las hur drag mo las phyogs kyi kag zlog bzhugs: 1$0000300༁ྃ: ྈྈྈ ྈ las hur drag mo la phyag 'tshal lo: phyogs kyi kag zlog ma sgrub thabs: dkyil 'khor med cing gtor ma med: spro na dmar gtor gcig bcas so: mdun du phyogs kyi kag zlog ma: sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dzin: lha mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: dmar ser dar 'dung sku la gsol: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: de yi thugs ka'i phyaṃ yig las: 'od zer dpag tu med 'phros pas: phyogs kyi kag zlog spyan drangs nas: bsgoms pa de yi sku la thim: phyaṃ mar phyogs zlog: de yis phyogs kyi kag zlog 'grub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ kha thaṃ gu hya: ྈྈ ྈ ces pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum bya lo dbo zla'i tshes lnga la lha mo phyogs kyi kag zlog ma nyid kyis dngos su gsungs so/// /
